The '''Battle of Null''' was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Republic 65">[[Republic 65|''Republic'' 65]]</ref> [[Null/Legends|Null]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|19.42 BBY]], approximately two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and seven [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="NEC" />

Motivated by a desire for order and the hatred of their [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|leader]], the rogue [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Spar]], for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] due to their part in the [[Battle of Galidraan|massacre]] of the [[True Mandalorians]] at [[Galidraan/Legends|Galidraan]],<ref name="GAW" /> the [[Mandalorian Supercommando|Supercommandos]]<ref name="NEC" /> of the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] entered the Clone Wars on the side of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]],<ref name="GAW" /> striking against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-aligned [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at Null.<ref name="NEC" />
